$comment: Facts about Base that the deployment record does not hold, read on chain (mainnet.base.org) on 2026-11-09. Core contract addresses never go here: they come from gully-core-8453.json.
name: Base
deployedAtBlockSource: First block with code at the deployment record's Vault, by bisecting eth_getCode (Sourcify holds no creation data for it on Base).
contractBlockTimeSource: 50,000 blocks in 10,000 s (0.2 s), 2026-11-09. OP Stack: NUMBER equals eth_blockNumber.
quoteTokenSource: None: pools quote in the native coin (nativeValueTransfers true), so the record names no quote ERC-20 (defaultQuote returns native).
reusedSource: Multicall3 at its canonical address; eth_getCode returned the same 3,813-byte runtime on Robinhood, Base and BNB, 2026-11-09. The deployment record does not list it because Gully Core did not deploy it.
